title: Revit governed documentation and export preparation
test_intent: Determine whether applicable Revit PDF, NWC, IFC, or RVT outputs use a governed source scope, approved or project-governed export configuration, governed naming/destination, required spatial/data mappings, and traceable validation evidence without relying on draft example defaults.

applicability.applies_when: A Revit documentation, coordination, submission, handover, or other governed output is being prepared or reviewed.
applicability.not_applicable_when: No Revit-derived output or governed export event is within the tested scope.

required_evidence: declared output purpose, format, discipline/scope, and issue or lifecycle context
governed source view, sheet set, or model/container scope
applicable export configuration or explicitly governed project configuration basis
applicable S3/S4/S7 naming and destination authority
property, parameter, or schema mapping where required
exporter/application version and output validation evidence

result_logic.pass: The output is produced from the governed source scope using an available approved or explicitly governed project configuration; identity and destination resolve through current S3/S4/S7 authority; required spatial and information mappings are preserved; and the output has the required traceable validation evidence.
result_logic.fail: A positive violation is found, including export from an arbitrary working view, use of an unapproved local configuration where an approved configuration exists, conflict with governed naming/destination rules, incorrect coordinate or property behavior against an available requirement, or missing required validation/evidence.
result_logic.not_applicable: No governed Revit-derived output is within the tested scope.
result_logic.indeterminate: The applicable output requirement, export configuration, naming/destination authority, coordinate basis, data mapping, or validation expectation is unavailable or incomplete, so conformance cannot be determined without inventing expected values.

provenance.migration_note: Appendix E ATS for Revit documentation/export conformance. Draft source filename patterns, folder paths, PDF settings, NWC options, IFC defaults, and view names remain noncanonical; missing approved configuration yields indeterminate rather than invented authority.
